visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress and a white fuzzy coat, sits in the back of a car. She uses a cushion sponge to apply makeup with a distressed, anxious expression while looking into a handheld mirror. (2) The woman opens her mouth wide and screams intensely at the camera in a close-up shot, appearing hysterical with her teeth bared. (3) On a rainy city street, she initially walks confidently, smiling at the camera with sparkles edited around her. Suddenly, she is splashed by water from a passing vehicle, leaving her hair and face drenched and her expression devastated. (4) The woman arrives at a POYA retail store entrance and enters. (5) Inside the brightly lit store and in a bathroom setting, she demonstrates various beauty products including makeup remover, face wipes, and sunscreen. She shows herself cleansing her face, applying wipes to her T-zone, and spreading lotion on her hands and forehead. (6) She stands in front of store shelves displaying shampoo and hair dye boxes, smiling broadly and gesturing towards the products with high energy. (7) She holds up a series of promotional posters and a pink designer makeup bag gift in the store aisle. (8) In the final shot, she poses confidently in front of the POYA logo, tossing her hair with a refreshed look.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, bright electronic BGM starts immediately. A female voice with an urgent, commanding tone shouts 'Today is your big day!' (2) A loud, sharp cartoonish screaming SFX triggers as the BGM tempo maintains. (3) A realistic water splashing SFX occurs, followed by a dramatic drop in musical energy. (4) A bell chime SFX marks the entrance to the store, and the BGM transitions to a cheerful, high-energy pop beat with steady electronic percussion. (5) Multiple 'pop' and 'bubble' SFX occur as product names appear on screen. The main speaker's voice is friendly and fast-paced, describing product features with clear articulation. (6) Whoosh SFX are used for rapid scene transitions while the BGM remains continuous and upbeat.
